verse: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verse_spoken: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous;
with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I begin this day by thanking you for your goodness.
Your Word says your favour surrounds your children like a shield.
Surround me today, Lord, in every room I enter and every task I face.
Open doors that I could never open on my own.
Give me grace with the people I meet, and wisdom in every conversation.
Where I have been overlooked, let your hand lift me up in your perfect time.
Keep my heart humble, so that any favour I receive points back to you.
Let me be a blessing to others, sharing the kindness you show me.
Let everyone praying with me walk in your favour and your peace today.
